blockers.missing: an existing-building setback check needs a current survey tying the building frame to the property lines
blockers.why: A setback rule by itself does not establish where an existing building sits.

blockers.missing: a project-height check needs a dimensioned height analysis using the City’s required grade and roof measurement rules
blockers.why: A plan label cannot be compared until its grade, highest point, roof treatment, and angled-plane measurements use the City’s method.

blockers.missing: a project FAR check needs a floor-area worksheet showing what counts toward FAR and a verified legal premises area
blockers.why: The counted floor area and legal premises area must both use the applicable City definitions.
